what: test-utils minicore.rs lacks two things real core has, which blaze-diagnostics UI tests need. (1) Integer MIN/MAX: there is no `impl usize { pub const MAX }`, so tests::bodies::const_patterns::exclusive_ranges_one_apart_and_overlapping_endpoints_are_linted gets E0599 on `0..usize::MAX`. Proposal: in region int_impl (or a new region int_consts), add `pub const MIN: Self` and `pub const MAX: Self` to each impl_int type, with the type's values. (2) `impl Default for bool` (false) under default + builtin_impls; tests::lints::syntax::delims::values::a_labelled_break_of_a_name_before_a_block_keeps_its_parentheses gets E0277 `bool: Default`. I set that test's flags to `default, ord, builtin_impls`; for (1) tell me the flag name and I will add it to the const_patterns test.
